app.name: My native preparation
welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.tagline: Read, practise and test yourself. Your data stays on your device.
welcome.registerHint: New here? Get your own 12-word key.
welcome.loginHint: Already have your 12 words? Log in on this device.
register.title: Your 12-word key
register.intro: These 12 words are your key. They open your data on this device and on any new device.
register.warning: Save them somewhere safe now. Nobody can recover them for you: if you lose them, your data can never be opened again.
register.copyFailed: Copying did not work. Select the words and copy them by hand.
register.error: Could not create your key. Please try again.
register.replaceWarning: This device already has saved data. A new key cannot open it, so that data would become unreadable. If you already have 12 words, go back and use Login instead.
fingerprint.title: Fingerprint lock (optional)
fingerprint.intro: Use your phone's fingerprint, face or screen lock to open the app. The app never sees your fingerprint.
fingerprint.levelStrong: On this device the lock also protects the key that opens your data.
fingerprint.levelGate: On this device the lock protects the app screen, not the files.
fingerprint.unsupported: This device or browser cannot use a fingerprint lock. You can still use your 12 words.
fingerprint.cancelled: The fingerprint lock was not turned on.
fingerprint.failed: Could not turn on the fingerprint lock. You can try again later in Settings.
fingerprint.noKey: This step needs the key made when you registered. You can turn the fingerprint lock on later in Settings. Continue for now.
info.title: About you (optional)
info.intro: The app works without these details. You can skip this step.
info.name: Name
info.emailInvalid: This email does not look right.
info.saveFailed: Could not save. You can skip now and add it later.
privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.noServer: This app has no server and no account. Your name, email, phone, progress and scores stay on this device, encrypted with a key made from your 12 words.
privacy.noRecovery: The developer cannot read them and nobody can recover them if you lose the 12 words. The app does not back up anything by itself; you can save an encrypted backup file wherever you like.
privacy.notHidden: Course names, which lessons you opened and the dates of your tests are not hidden.
privacy.github: Checking for updates and downloading courses contacts GitHub.
privacy.failed: Could not finish. Please press OK again.
login.title: Log in
login.intro: Enter your 12 words. You can paste them or type them with a space between each word.
login.label: Your 12 words
login.wrongCount: This looks like {count} words, we need 12.
login.wrongCountOne: This looks like 1 word, we need 12.
login.unknownWord: Word number {n} is not on the word list. Check the spelling.
login.badChecksum: These 12 words are not a valid key. A word may be mistyped or in the wrong order.
login.wrongKey: These words do not open the data on this device. Check them and try again.
login.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
passphrase.title: Your 12 words
passphrase.body: Your 12 words are your key. They are never stored in this app. You need them to log in on a new device, after clearing the browser, or after logging out. If you lose them, nobody can recover your data.
passphrase.logoutWarn: After logging out you need your 12 words to log in again. Your data stays on this device, encrypted.
passphrase.logoutFailed: Could not log out. Please try again.
fingerprint.screen.intro: Use your fingerprint, face or screen lock to open the app next time, instead of typing your 12 words. This step is optional.
fingerprint.screen.words: Your 12 words always work. You need them on a new phone, after clearing the browser, or after logging out.
fingerprint.screen.private: The app never sees your fingerprint or face. Your phone checks it.
fingerprint.screen.unavailable: This device or browser cannot use a fingerprint or screen lock here. You can skip this step.
fingerprint.screen.cancelled: No problem, the fingerprint lock was not turned on. You can try again or skip.
fingerprint.screen.failed: Could not turn on the fingerprint lock. You can try again or skip this step.
fingerprint.screen.noKey: To turn on the fingerprint lock, log in with your 12 words first. You can skip this step and do it later in Settings.
fingerprint.screen.donePrf: Fingerprint lock is on. Opening the app now needs your fingerprint, face or screen lock, and it protects your data on this device.
fingerprint.screen.doneGate: Fingerprint lock is on. On this device it protects the app screen, not the files.
fingerprint.card.title: Fingerprint lock
fingerprint.card.intro: Use your fingerprint, face or screen lock to open the app instead of typing your 12 words. This is optional, and your 12 words always still work.
fingerprint.card.stateOff: Fingerprint lock is off. Your 12 words open the app.
fingerprint.card.unavailable: This device or browser cannot use a fingerprint or screen lock here.
fingerprint.card.cancelled: No problem, the fingerprint lock was not turned on. You can try again any time.
fingerprint.card.failed: Could not turn on the fingerprint lock. Please try again.
fingerprint.card.turnOffFailed: Could not turn off the fingerprint lock. Please try again.
fingerprint.card.wordsPrompt: To turn on the fingerprint lock, enter your 12 words once more. They are used right now and are not saved.
fingerprint.card.badWords: These 12 words do not look right. Check them and try again.
fingerprint.card.wrongKey: These words do not open the data on this device. Check them and try again.
pin.enter.title: Enter your PIN
pin.enter.intro: Enter your 6-digit PIN to open the app.
pin.enter.label: PIN
pin.enter.tooMany: Too many wrong PINs, so the PIN lock was removed. Log in with your 12 words.
pin.enter.failed: Could not open the app with the PIN. Try again or use your 12 words.
pin.setup.title: PIN lock
pin.setup.intro: Lock the app with a 6-digit PIN. This is optional, and your 12 words always still work.
pin.setup.honest: A PIN stops other people who pick up your open phone or computer. It is not as strong as your 12 words: someone who copies the data files from this device could try every PIN.
pin.setup.tries: Five wrong PINs in a row remove the PIN lock, and then you need your 12 words once.
pin.setup.done: PIN lock is on. Opening the app now needs your PIN.
pin.setup.wrongLength: The PIN must be exactly 6 digits.
pin.setup.tooEasy: That PIN is too easy to guess (like 123456 or 111111). Choose another one.
pin.setup.mismatch: The two PINs are different. Type the same PIN twice.
pin.setup.noKey: To turn on the PIN lock, log in with your 12 words first. You can skip this step.
pin.setup.failed: Could not turn on the PIN lock. Please try again or skip this step.
pin.card.title: PIN lock
pin.card.intro: Lock the app with a 6-digit PIN. This is optional, and your 12 words always still work. A PIN is not as strong as your 12 words.
pin.card.stateOn: PIN lock is on. Opening the app needs your PIN, unless your fingerprint opens it.
pin.card.wordsPrompt: To turn on the PIN lock, enter your 12 words once more. They are used right now and are not saved.
pin.card.badWords: These 12 words do not look right. Check them and try again.
pin.card.wrongKey: These words do not open the data on this device. Check them and try again.
pin.card.turnOffFailed: Could not turn off the PIN lock. Please try again.
pin.card.offNotSaved: PIN lock is off. This browser could not keep you logged in, so the next time you open the app you need your 12 words.

admin.title: Admin
admin.login.title: Admin login
admin.login.intro: Enter your GitHub access token to edit the courses. It is kept only in the memory of this tab: it is never saved and never sent anywhere except to GitHub.
admin.login.hint: It starts with github_pat_. Create it in your GitHub settings (Contents: read and write, only for the content repository).
admin.err.invalidToken: This does not look like a GitHub token. Paste it again without spaces.
admin.err.unauthorized: GitHub did not accept this token. It may be wrong, expired or revoked.
admin.err.forbidden: GitHub refused this token for the content repository. Check its permissions.
admin.err.noPush: This token can read the repository but cannot change it. It needs Contents: read and write.
admin.err.rateLimited: GitHub asks to slow down. Wait a few minutes and try again.
admin.err.notFound: The content repository was not found for this token. Check that the token is for that repository.
admin.err.offline: Could not reach GitHub. Check the internet connection and try again.
admin.err.timeout: GitHub did not answer in time. Please try again.
admin.err.badResponse: GitHub sent an answer the app could not understand. Please try again later.
admin.home.branchWarn: The default branch of this repository is {branch}, which is not the one the editor expects. Tell the developer before publishing.

admin.courses.empty: There are no courses yet. Add the first one.
